panels.title: Overview
panels.description: Collection and Coverage apply to the whole Bob source. Complete means collection finished without source errors, skipped records, invalid values, unsafe subtask reconciliation or unknown tool outcomes. Token fields omitted by Bob do not make coverage Partial. Chats and Chats with token counts use the same Project, Chat and time range; the latter requires recorded input and output, including zero. Recorded tokens sums known chat totals only; compare the two chat counts to see how many contribute. See Chats for missing-token reasons. Cached table values remain subject to Collection and Scan age. Tokens: K = thousand, Mil = million, Bil = billion.

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Recorded history for chats with a saved message in the selected range. Project and Chat filter these values. Tokens: K = thousand, Mil = million, Bil = billion. Input already includes cached tokens. Charts begin when Prometheus starts scraping. Gaps indicate unavailable collection. Known values remain visible when other chats lack counts; compare Chats with Chats with token counts in Overview and read Token counts in the Chats table.

panels.description: Recorded history for chats with a saved message in the selected range. Project and Chat filter these values. Counts are saved tool results, not tool requests or shell exit codes. Unknown outcomes make the totals partial. Duration covers results with duration metadata.

panels.title: Chat activity
panels.description: Chats with a saved message in the preceding five minutes at each point. This measures recent messages, not whether an agent is currently running. Project and Chat filters apply.

panels.title: Chats
panels.description: Recorded history for selected chats. Tokens includes cached input. Token counts: Recorded means input and output are valid; Token counts not recorded by Bob means a saved field is absent or null; Token counts unavailable means an invalid value, unsafe subtask subtraction or an older collector without status. Collection unavailable / stale takes precedence over saved reasons. Numeric cells stay blank for missing values. Source-wide Coverage is separate from token availability. Tokens: K = thousand, Mil = million, Bil = billion. https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/ibm-bob-beta/#read-the-values
